raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 has a late partial re-delivery (max ingest_ts 2026-01-17 22:00 against a 02:00 load, and 366 rows against about 350 in other batches). It replayed already-loaded txn_ids, and silver_transactions has no dedup, so 20 txn_ids appear twice. The fix keeps one POSTED row per txn_id, taking the latest ingest. The gold tables rebuild from silver and are corrected downstream.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC, amount DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
